thread:
Emma (Growth): Quick sync — prepping launch posts + webinar funnel. Need final KW list, schema plan for the landing, internal linking targets, and a redirect (301) map for legacy promo pages. Who can take which? :calendar:
Javi: I can own redirects. Will run a crawl and output a flat 301 map by EOD. Will also audit redirect chains and canonical tags. :white_check_mark:
Liz: Sending a pared-down keyword shortlist now — focusing on purchase intent + feature queries. Will post the list in a sec.
Liz: KW shortlist (draft): inference platform, LLM inference latency, cost-aware inference, dedicated GPU inference, inference caching strategies
Ben-Marketing: For the benchmark narrative, can we reuse last quarter's structure but swap in latency/cost metrics? Need a 1-paragraph hook for the webinar invite.
Sasha: For schema on the webinar landing: Event + Person for speakers, howTo for post-webinar replay steps, and structured FAQ. I'll draft JSON-LD. Remember to include startDate in ISO and sameAs links for speakers.
Omar: Inbound lead routing note — prefer routing webinar signups by region: APAC -> SDR_APAC queue, EMEA -> SDR_EMEA, NA -> SDR_NA. Also capture UTM_source + utm_term (keyword) in the hidden field so we can tie organic KW -> conversion.
Emma (Growth): Nice. Also, internal linking: prioritize linking from these three high-traffic blog posts to the landing page and to the new feature docs. Avoid adding links to /pricing in the blog flows.
analytics-bot: crawl report ready: 12 soft-404s flagged, 3 redirect chains >2 hops, 5 pages missing Event schema on landing candidates. Report: https://internal.crawl/reports/1714123456 (preview)
Javi: Copying the bot results. I'll collapse chains and set final endpoints. Proposed 301 map snippet:
```
/promo/old-launch -> /product/launch-2026 301
/blog/ai-old-webinar -> /webinar/ai-inference-ops 301
/docs/edge-cache -> /docs/inference-caching-setup 301
```
Liz: I updated the KW slots in the launch post template and changed H1 to include "LLM inference latency". Also added meta-description variant for A/B.
Ben-Marketing: Messaging tweak: emphasize measurable savings (tokens / cost / p50 latency). Hook idea: "Ship LLM features faster — at predictable latency and lower cost." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sasha: That hook works. For schema microdata, include aggregateRating on product pages only after we have review data — don't fake ratings.
Omar: For routing, we'll need the form to pass gateway param so the CRM can set lead owner. I'll coordinate with Integrations to add the hidden field 'kw_intent' populated from utm_term.
Emma (Growth): OK owners: Javi = redirects + canonical fixes; Sasha = schema + JSON-LD; Liz = final KW list + copy; Omar = form routing + hidden fields; Ben = benchmark narrative + webinar hook. I'll compile action items and assign PRs. Thanks all. :rocket:
Javi: I'll post the 301 map file to the #release-war-room channel when ready.
Sasha: Draft JSON-LD will go to the docs repo as a PR; ping me if you want me to inline on the page.
analytics-bot: follow-up crawl scheduled for tomorrow 0600 UTC to validate 301s and schema updates.
Emma (Growth): Perfect — catchups tomorrow 10am PT.
